entry.title: LLM-agent workflow reports new proofs on positivity problems in algebraic combinatorics
entry.summary: A preprint describes PatternMiner, in which an LLM agent generates mathematical datasets, trains small models (MLPs, small transformers, trees), interprets them and formulates conjectures that are tested against counterexamples in mathematical software, applied to five positivity problems from… (Discovery - University of Washington; Pacific Northwest National Laboratory; announced 2026-11-25)

entry.title: Deep learning predicts DNA damage response protein levels from routine slides
entry.summary: Gated attention-based multiple-instance learning on frozen pathology foundation-model tile embeddings predicted reverse-phase protein array pathway scores from 1,673 TCGA haematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images covering 1,527 patients with breast, endometrial, cervical and ovarian cancer and… (Discovery - Johns Hopkins University; Johns Hopkins School of Medicine; announced 2026-11-25)

entry.title: Machine learning forecasts acute food crises and separates predictive from causal drivers
entry.summary: Missing-data-resilient machine-learning pipelines, including gradient boosting and a tabular foundation model, forecast acute food crisis occurrence 3, 6 and 9 months ahead across 80 countries using monthly subnational data for 2007-2024, exceeding no-skill baselines by 15 to 50 percentage points… (Discovery - European Commission, Joint Research Centre; University of Valencia; Integrated Food Security Phase Classification Global Support Unit; announced 2026-11-25)

entry.title: Satellite machine learning measures inundation across 542,850 conserved wetland sites
entry.summary: A Support Vector Machine classifier applied to Sentinel-2 and Dynamic World data in Google Earth Engine mapped surface-water inundation across 542,850 wetland-related Conservation Reserve Program and Wetlands Reserve Program sites from 2018 to 2024. Measurable inundation occurred on 44.20% of CRP… (Discovery - University of Nebraska-Lincoln; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Machine learning selects an exploratory senescence-related gene score in PMOS
entry.summary: Using two public ovarian-cell datasets (13 PMOS and 9 control samples), univariate logistic regression, SVM-RFE and LASSO selected a five-gene SASP-related score (DYNLRB2, MMP9, A1BG, PGD, APLP2) with apparent AUC 0.991 on the development data and AUC 0.838 in an exploratory skeletal-muscle… (Discovery - Seventh People's Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; Changhai Hospital, Naval Medical University; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Multimodal machine learning prioritizes candidate inhibitors of giant cancer cells
entry.summary: A multimodal ensemble combining chemical fingerprints, drug-induced cell morphology, transcriptomic perturbation profiles and biological annotations was trained on screening data from four breast cancer cell lines, reaching mean Pearson correlation 0.403 and recovering 27.9% of experimentally… (Discovery - UPMC Hillman Cancer Center, University of Pittsburgh; Carnegie Mellon University; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Machine learning prioritises osteoarthritis genes tested under macrophage stretch
entry.summary: Random forest ranking and LASSO regression narrowed a 168-gene synovial co-expression module to five candidates (E2F3, C6orf211, NDUFC2, SPCS2, DOCK10) using public datasets (discovery 29 normal and 30 osteoarthritis samples; auxiliary GSE89408 with 28 and 22). The combined score reached AUC 0.817… (Discovery - Shuguang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; Shanghai Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Machine learning derives an exploratory two-gene signature in gastric cancer
entry.summary: Differential expression and summary-data-based Mendelian randomization on TCGA gastric cancer data prioritized 24 heat-shock-protein-associated genes, consensus clustering defined two molecular clusters, and LASSO-Cox regression derived an exploratory F7-PRNP prognostic signature. siRNA knockdown… (Discovery - China-Japan Union Hospital of Jilin University, Jilin University; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Generative AI designs Type I photosensitizers tested in cells and mice
entry.summary: A cross-attention classifier trained on 1,338 curated photosensitizers (85.8% accuracy and ROC-AUC 0.918 on a scaffold split) and an RNN scaffold-decorating generator proposed candidates on a redesigned tetracyclic scaffold. Six were synthesised and all produced superoxide under light. The lead… (Discovery - Hunan University; Hengyang Normal University; Second Xiangya Hospital, Central South University; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Deep learning EEG metric linked to mortality in obstructive sleep apnea
entry.summary: A deep-learning model trained on 22,044 polysomnography recordings estimated the apnea-hypopnea index from a single EEG channel, correlating r=0.88 with the scored index in internal testing and r=0.50 to 0.62 in three external test sets. Two derived metrics, the discrepancy between the EEG-based… (Discovery - Seoul National University; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Deep learning scores Claudin18.2 staining in gastric cancer slides across clones
entry.summary: A pipeline that scores Claudin18.2 immunohistochemistry on whole-slide images used a LoRA-adapted UNI pathology foundation model for tumour recognition, adapter-based staining-intensity classification and two rounds of active learning. Agreement with pathologist-consensus 2/3+ scoring was ICC… (Discovery - Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center; Sun Yat-sen University School of Computer Science and Engineering; Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: CheckUser "Get actions" exposes suppressed page titles
entry.summary: Special:CheckUser "Get actions" and the equivalent API showed a logs link whose URL contained suppressed page titles to users not allowed to see them. Wikimedia credits Claude as reporter. (Vulnerability - Wikimedia Foundation; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: CheckUser temporary-account IP reveal exposes suppressed AbuseLog performers
entry.summary: The CheckUser batch temporary-account IP reveal endpoint did not check whether the requester could see the AbuseLog entries named in a request, so hidden entries could be tied to a temporary account and its IP by trial and error. Wikimedia credits Claude as reporter. (Vulnerability - Wikimedia Foundation; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Thunderbird crafted email enables IMAP command injection and JavaScript execution
entry.summary: Mozilla documents that several combined weaknesses let a crafted email, when opened, inject commands into the authenticated IMAP connection and load a web page with JavaScript enabled in place of the message. Mozilla rates the impact high and credits Jeffrey Crowell - OpenAI Codex Security as… (Vulnerability - OpenAI; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: MediaWiki Action API rvdiffto bypasses cross-page read authorization
entry.summary: The MediaWiki Action API rvdiffto parameter could disclose revision text from a page the caller is not allowed to read, because it skipped the read check the normal web diff path applies. The Wikimedia CNA rates it CVSS 4.0 8.7 (High). The public Phabricator task was filed by AisleResearch, and… (Vulnerability - AISLE Research; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Erlang OTP binary_to_term heap overread via unterminated FLOAT_EXT
entry.summary: Out-of-bounds read in the Erlang OTP erts external term format decoder: a FLOAT_EXT term without a terminating zero byte passed to binary_to_term/1,2 lets the parser read memory after the input and change one byte there, which may abort the VM. The CNA rates it CVSS 4.0 6.9 (Medium). AISLE's case… (Vulnerability - AISLE Research; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Erlang OTP binary_to_term stack exhaustion via nested funs aborts the VM
entry.summary: Uncontrolled recursion in the Erlang OTP erts external term format decoder: funs nested in the integer fields of NEW_FUN_EXT or EXPORT_EXT terms passed to binary_to_term/1,2 can exhaust the stack and abort the VM. The CNA rates it CVSS 4.0 6.9 (Medium). AISLE's case page states it was discovered… (Vulnerability - AISLE Research; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Erlang OTP binary_to_term heap overrun via zero-length NEWER_REFERENCE_EXT aborts the VM
entry.summary: Out-of-bounds write in the Erlang OTP erts external term format decoder: a NEWER_REFERENCE_EXT term with a zero-length ID passed to binary_to_term/1,2 makes the decoder write past the reserved process heap and abort the whole VM. The CNA rates it CVSS 4.0 7.0 (High). AISLE's case page states it… (Vulnerability - AISLE Research; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Unsupervised clustering splits Ethiopian rainfall into ten seasonal regimes
entry.summary: Ward hierarchical and K-means clustering of 1981-2022 monthly rainfall, temperature and elevation from the Ethiopian Meteorological Institute's 4 km merged gridded data (more than 66,000 points) grouped Ethiopia into ten rainy-season regimes, with the number of clusters chosen by the elbow method… (Discovery - Addis Ababa University; Ethiopian Meteorological Institute; Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Machine learning links a plasma protein signature to symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection
entry.summary: In the population-based Gutenberg COVID-19 Study, mass-spectrometry plasma proteomics of 494 post-infection and 190 pre-infection samples (paired samples from 189 participants) was analyzed with bootstrap mRMR ensemble feature selection and ridge regression, identifying 49 proteins associated with… (Discovery - University Medical Center of the Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz; Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin; Institute of Molecular Biology (IMB), Mainz; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: LLM-guided robotic workflow finds a high-entropy Prussian blue urea-oxidation catalyst
entry.summary: The workflow combined retrieval-grounded LLM candidate generation, theory-informed machine learning with applicability-domain screening and robotic high-throughput experiments, with human judgment in problem formulation and prioritization. Of 40 robotically tested compositions… (Discovery - University of Science and Technology of China; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Language model beats billing codes at reconstructing pregnancy episodes from notes
entry.summary: A large language model given chronologically concatenated clinical notes and messages identified pregnancy episodes and extracted gestational age, outcome, assisted-reproduction treatment and complications for 30 patients with 74 pregnancies. On a held-out set of 20 patients (54 pregnancies)… (Discovery - University of California, San Francisco; U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Deep learning on lung-screening CT estimates spirometry in two external cohorts
entry.summary: A three-dimensional convolutional neural network trained on 10,371 low-dose CT reconstructions from 5,975 NLST participants was fused with 20 densitometry and tracheal geometry features to predict FEV1, FVC and FEV1/FVC. Applied frozen to an external screening cohort (n = 268) and COPDGene (10,302… (Discovery - University of Florida; D’Or Institute for Research and Education; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: AI-measured retinal vessel metrics nominally linked to cognitive impairment in diabetes
entry.summary: In 630 community-dwelling adults with type 2 diabetes from four Guiyang health centres, the EVision AI system quantified retinal vascular density and fractal dimensions from fundus photographs. Mild cognitive impairment by MoCA-B affected 33.2% (n=209); after adjustment, vascular density (OR 0.987… (Discovery - Guizhou Center for Disease Control and Prevention; Affiliated Hospital of Guizhou Medical University; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Machine learning designs a root microbial community for alfalfa in saline-alkali soil
entry.summary: From 327 salt-alkali-tolerant root bacterial strains, 20 complementary strains were assembled into 134 stochastic synthetic communities tested in germination assays. Random forest and elastic-net GLM models then selected five key strains for the community SP3. In pot experiments under salt-alkali… (Discovery - Harbin Normal University; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: FT-IR spectroscopy with a neural network serotypes Streptococcus pneumoniae prospectively
entry.summary: An artificial neural network on FT-IR spectra (1,603 spectra, 27 serogroups/serotypes) reached 100% cross-validation accuracy. In prospective blind testing of 70 clinical isolates it agreed with the Quellung reaction for 69 (98.6%) and separated vaccine-escape strains 19A, 3 and 6C. An untested… (Discovery - Faculdades Pequeno Príncipe; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: Interpretable stacking model predicts demoralization syndrome in hemodialysis patients
entry.summary: A 12-predictor Stacking-Ridge model was developed in a prospective cohort of 592 maintenance hemodialysis patients and had AUC 0.922 (95% CI 0.883-0.955) in external validation (n = 245), with recall 0.652 and precision 0.714. SHAP highlighted urinary microalbumin, PHQ-9 and HALP score. Follow-up… (Discovery - Wuhan University of Science and Technology; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: CT Transformer model stratifies nodal metastasis risk in papillary thyroid carcinoma
entry.summary: ThyLNT, a Transformer-based 2.5D deep learning model on preoperative CT, was developed in 1560 patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma from six hospitals. AUC was 0.787 in internal validation and 0.772 to 0.827 across five external cohorts, with calibration and threshold-dependent performance… (Discovery - Tongji Hospital, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Machine-learning feature selection nominates GUCA2B as a colorectal cancer biomarker
entry.summary: Four ML algorithms selected features from 850 downregulated genes, giving a frozen eight-gene logistic model that included GUCA2B. Its apparent AUC was 0.998 in TCGA-COADREAD (training) and 0.881-0.974 in three independent cohorts. Restoring GUCA2B in HCT-116 cells induced apoptosis and reduced… (Discovery - Hamedan University of Medical Sciences; Isfahan University of Medical Sciences; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: EC-guided transfer learning finds SHMT2/MTHFD2 compounds that lower fibroblast collagen
entry.summary: Pre-training a deep feedforward network on the nearest Enzyme Commission family with enough ChEMBL data gave usable drug-target models for SHMT2 (6 known actives) and MTHFD2 (29), where training from scratch failed (MCC 0.00 for SHMT2). Virtual screening of DrugBank gave six candidates… (Discovery - University of Edinburgh; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Machine-learning MIRA-29 score predicts neurological outcome after cardiac arrest
entry.summary: MIRA-29 was derived on a prospective cohort of 1099 out-of-hospital cardiac arrest patients (85, 7.7%, had a favorable neurological outcome), with machine learning and genetic algorithms used to optimize a model from five candidate variables, and age was not retained in the final model. External… (Discovery - INSERM; Université de Bretagne Occidentale; Laboratoire de Traitement de l'Information Médicale; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Graph-Transformer and coarse-grained simulation discover self-assembling cyclic peptides
entry.summary: Several previously unreported disulfide-cyclized self-assembling peptides were identified, and experimental characterization agreed with predictions. (Discovery - Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, China; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Firefly-Geni LLM-assisted generative framework proposes TADF molecules, one synthesized
entry.summary: Firefly-Geni uses LLM-assisted literature data extraction, a multitask property predictor, a conditional molecular generator and quantum-chemical feedback. From 100,000 molecules generated for a singlet-triplet gap of 0.05 eV and synthetic accessibility score 2.5, it identified 100 structurally… (Discovery - Donghua University; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Random forest and assays identify novel ACE-inhibitory peptides in duckweed hydrolysates
entry.summary: Random forest, PLS and linear regression and correlation linked peptide ion volumes in 407 peptides to ACE and DPP-IV inhibition. Of 20 selected peptides, 16 showed ACE inhibition and were novel; WKLPMF had ACE IC50 13.40 +/- 0.40 uM and DPP-IV IC50 216.89 +/- 5.15 uM. All activity is in vitro. (Discovery - PROTEO; Université Laval; Institut sur la nutrition et les aliments fonctionnels (INAF); announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: AI classifies nasopharyngeal narrow-band images and improves reader agreement
entry.summary: A segmentation and five-class Ni classification system was trained on 5404 retrospectively collected NBI images. In two external cohorts accuracy was 0.889 and 0.873 (AUC 0.976 and 0.967), and in recorded video 0.888 (AUC 0.974). In a randomized crossover reader study with 12 physicians and 200… (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; Cancer Hospital of Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Structured AI ideation proposes physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair
entry.summary: The Abelio AI system proposed membrane-tethered PEG and cholesterol-anchored complementary DNA as physical interventions for epithelial barrier restoration, with both proposals archived before experiments. In damaged Caco-2 monolayers PEG preserved barrier function in a membrane-surface-dependent… (Discovery - Not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Machine learning screens hardness and oxidation resistance in refractory alloys
entry.summary: XGBoost hardness and random forest oxidation models (held-out R2 0.79 and 0.76) screened 109,571 quinary compositions, and six alloys were fabricated for contrasting hardness-oxidation trade-offs, with measured hardness up to 780 +/- 8 HV and a lowest specific mass gain of 2.75 +/- 0.04 mg/cm2… (Discovery - Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique; National Tsing Hua University; Institut de Chimie de la Matière Condensée de Bordeaux; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Deep learning on routine chest radiographs assesses major osteoporotic fracture risk
entry.summary: A convolutional neural network survival model was developed in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated in 85,284 patients from two other institutions. In external validation it reached a C-index of 0.843 (95% CI 0.837-0.850) and a 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI 0.846-0.863)… (Discovery - Seoul National University; Seoul National University Hospital; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Voice-based auditory AI assists clinicians assessing laryngeal disease before laryngoscopy
entry.summary: An auditory large language model produced pre-laryngoscopy assessment cards and a malignancy alert from voice recordings. In a paired study with 32 clinicians and 800 assessments, accuracy rose from 49.8% to 56.8%, and sensitivity for precancerous or malignant lesions from 53.9% to 75.0%. The… (Discovery - Not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: Active learning designs selective growth media for six bacteria
entry.summary: A sequential active learning framework with multi-objective gradient-boosting decision tree models predicted formulations from 30 common components that maximize target bacterial growth and minimize non-target growth, for six phylogenetically diverse bacteria. Iterative cycles of prediction and… (Discovery - University of Tsukuba; announced 2026-11-15)
